description: This PHP class is a Symfony event subscriber that listens for exceptions during HTTP request processing. When it detects a specific exception (`RequestForwardableException`), it forwards the request to a different controller specified by the exception, sets the new response, and stops further propagation of the event.

classes.name: RequestForwardableExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that handles specific exceptions during HTTP request processing by forwarding requests to a different controller when a `RequestForwardableException` is encountered.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the exception event with priority 0.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event; if the exception is `RequestForwardableException`, it forwards the request to another controller, sets the response, and stops event propagation.
